_comment: Per-test kept-red expectation manifest for issue #1628 (ronde 10 paired proof). Read by apps/front/scripts/ci/run-preuves.mts BEFORE classification. Each test declared in `expectedRed` MUST fail with an AssertionError on correct code. If a declared kept-red test PASSES, the runner fails CI with verdict CORRUPT PROOF. The `measuredAgainst` SHA points at the commit that introduced the proof itself (f915c3c1e), so the runner has an audit trail for the proof's provenance.

expectedRed.testName: publish-now row selector is missing the { hasText: postBody } filter (defect: postRow() matches stale rows on a shared tenant)
expectedRed.why: On correct code postRow() filters by { hasText: postBody }, so `expect(filterPresent).toBe(false)` fails with an AssertionError — the kept-red state. If this test PASSES, the postRow() filter has been removed and the publish-now feature can be silently broken while the test stays green on a shared tenant.

expectedRed.testName: publish-now final invariant is missing the getByText(postBody) check (defect: stale link could satisfy the loop without the row carrying the composed body)
expectedRed.why: On correct code the spec carries a final invariant that verifies a row with the freshly-composed postBody exists in the history table body. The proof asserts the invariant is MISSING, so `expect(invariantPresent).toBe(false)` fails with an AssertionError on correct code. If this test PASSES, the invariant has been removed and a stale link could satisfy the loop without the row carrying the composed body.
